faculty.name: Peter Blake
faculty.summary: Studies how children decide when to share or compete for resources, using game theory experiments with candy and stickers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童在资源分配中何时分享或竞争的认知和社会过程，使用糖果和贴纸的游戏理论实验。

faculty.name: Catherine Caldwell-Harris
faculty.summary: Studies emotional aspects of language, second language acquisition, and word recognition, using techniques like repetition blindness and skin conductance responses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言的情感方面、二语习得和词识别，使用重复盲视和皮肤电反应等技术。

faculty.name: Chandramouli Chandrasekaran
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes complex sensory inputs and makes decisions, using electrophysiological and computational techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理复杂的感觉输入并做出决策，使用电生理学和计算方法。

faculty.name: Rachel Denison
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain generates ongoing perceptual experience, focusing on visual perception, attention, and decision-making using behavioral and neural measurements.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何生成持续的知觉体验，重点关注视觉感知、注意力和决策过程，使用行为和神经测量方法。

faculty.name: Michael Hasselmo
faculty.summary: Studies the cortical dynamics of memory-guided behavior, using neurophysiological techniques and computational modeling in rats.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆引导行为的皮层动态，使用神经生理学技术和计算建模方法在大鼠中进行。

faculty.name: Marc Howard
faculty.summary: Develops mathematical models of episodic memory and evaluates them with behavioral and neurophysiological data, covering statistical learning and reward systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发情景记忆的数学模型，并通过行为和神经生理数据进行评估，涵盖统计学习和奖赏系统。

faculty.name: Mark Howe
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuit principles in the basal ganglia for adaptive behavior using two-photon microscopy, fiber photometry, and electrophysiology in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基底节的神经环路原则以适应行为，使用双光子显微镜、光纤光度计和电生理学技术在小鼠中进行。

faculty.name: Deborah Kelemen
faculty.summary: Studies how children develop concepts of the natural and artificial world, focusing on religious and scientific theory-formation, object categorization, and social learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展对自然和人造世界的概念，重点关注宗教和科学理论形成、物体分类和社会学习。

faculty.name: Melissa Kibbe
faculty.summary: Studies how infants, children, and adults process and store visual information, focusing on object representations, working memory, and cognitive interactions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿、儿童和成人如何处理和存储视觉信息，重点在于对象表征、工作记忆和认知交互。

faculty.name: Arthur Lee
faculty.summary: Studies mental states through neural patterns and predicts behaviors using functional neuroimaging methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过神经模式解码心理状态，并使用功能性神经影像学方法预测行为。

faculty.name: Sam Ling
faculty.summary: Studies how attention filters visual information by altering basic brain response properties, using psychophysics, computational modeling, TMS, and fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意如何通过改变基本的脑反应属性来过滤视觉信息，采用心理物理学、计算建模、经颅磁刺激（TMS）和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）的方法。

faculty.name: Qimin Liu
faculty.summary: Studies emotional disturbances in adults, focusing on affective phenomenology, statistical methods, and intersectional marginalization.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成人情绪障碍，关注情感现象学、统计方法和交叉边缘化。

faculty.name: Kristin Long
faculty.summary: Studies the reciprocal influences between a child’s medical illness or disability and their family and cultural context, focusing on health disparities in autism diagnosis and treatment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的医学疾病或残疾与其家庭和文化背景之间的相互影响，重点关注自闭症诊断和治疗中的健康不平等。

faculty.name: Tara Mandalaywala
faculty.summary: Studies how children and nonhuman animals reason about social status and essentialist beliefs, using developmental psychology and comparative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和非人类动物如何根据社会地位和本质主义信念进行推理，使用发展心理学和比较方法。

faculty.name: Joseph McGuire
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain represents subjective value and economic utility, and how these processes relate to self-control and decision-making under uncertainty.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何表征主观价值和经济效用，以及这些过程如何与自我控制和不确定性下的决策相关。

faculty.name: Samuel Meisel
faculty.summary: Studies how social relationships influence adolescent substance use, using developmental science to improve treatments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社交关系如何影响青少年物质滥用，并利用发展科学改进治疗方法。

faculty.name: Heidi Meyer
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Kate Nussenbaum
faculty.summary: Studies developmental changes in value-guided learning, memory, and exploration using behavioral tasks and fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究从儿童到成年时期的价值导向学习、记忆和探索的发展变化，使用行为任务和fMRI。

faculty.name: Michael Otto
faculty.summary: Develops and validates new psychosocial treatments for mood, anxiety, and substance use disorders, focusing on brain-behavior relationships in therapeutic learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和验证针对情绪障碍、焦虑障碍和物质使用障碍的新心理社会治疗方法，关注治疗学习中的脑-行为关系。

faculty.name: Tibor Palfai
faculty.summary: Develops psychological interventions to reduce health risk behaviors, focusing on web and mobile-based interventions for substance use and screening in medical settings.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发心理干预措施以减少健康风险行为，重点关注基于网络和移动设备的干预措施以减少物质使用，并在医疗环境中进行筛查。

faculty.name: Donna Pincus
faculty.summary: Studies children's fears and anxieties, developing treatments and examining coping with stress and medical conditions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童恐惧和焦虑，开发治疗方法并探讨应对压力和医疗条件的心理因素。

faculty.name: Yakeel Quiroz
faculty.summary: Studies early cognitive and biological markers of Alzheimer’s disease in families with autosomal dominant Alzheimer’s disease, focusing on identifying protective mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病早期认知和生物标志物，特别是在携带早发性常染色体显性遗传阿尔茨海默病突变的家庭中，寻找保护机制。

faculty.name: Steve Ramirez
faculty.summary: Studies how memories are formed and retrieved, using optogenetics and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆的形成与检索，使用光遗传学和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Robert M. G. Reinhart
faculty.summary: Studies the neural rhythms and mechanisms underlying human cognition, using electrophysiology, neuroimaging, and neuromodulation to enhance cognitive functions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类认知背后的神经节奏和机制，使用电生理学、神经成像和神经调节技术来增强认知功能。

faculty.name: Kimberly Saudino
faculty.summary: Studies the development of infant and child temperament, focusing on activity level and the genetic and environmental factors influencing it.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童气质的发展，特别是活动水平，并探讨遗传和环境因素的影响。

faculty.name: Benjamin Scott
faculty.summary: Develops and applies new technologies to study the neural basis of cognition and complex learned behavior, combining biomedical engineering and neuroethology.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和应用新技术研究认知和复杂学习行为的神经基础，结合生物医学工程和神经生态学。

faculty.name: David Somers
faculty.summary: Studies the brain circuits supporting visual perception and cognition using fMRI, psychophysics, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像、心理物理学和计算建模研究支持视觉感知和认知的大脑电路。

faculty.name: Amelia Stanton
faculty.summary: Studies psychological barriers to sexual and reproductive health, focusing on marginalized populations and developing interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性与生殖健康的心理障碍，重点关注边缘化群体，并开发干预措施。

faculty.name: Chantal Stern
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain encodes, stores, and recognizes visual, spatial, and verbal information using fMRI, with a focus on memory processes and aging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码、存储和识别视觉、空间和语言信息，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI），重点关注记忆过程和老化。

faculty.name: Amanda Tarullo
faculty.summary: Studies how early life stress affects infant brain development and predicts later socio-emotional and cognitive outcomes using EEG.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期生活压力对婴儿大脑发展的影响及其与后期社会情感和认知结果的关系，使用EEG进行测量。

faculty.name: Nicholas Wagner
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of early relationships on children’s social and emotional development, focusing on self-regulation and psychopathology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期关系对儿童社会和情绪发展的影响，重点关注自我调节和心理障碍。

faculty.name: Helen Barbas
faculty.summary: Studies the organization of the prefrontal cortex and its role in central executive functions in primates, using neural tracers and imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵长类前额叶皮层的组织及其在中央执行功能中的作用，使用神经示踪剂和成像技术。

faculty.name: Rhoda Au
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive aging and dementia using multi-sensory brain health monitoring technologies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知老化和痴呆症，使用多感官脑健康监测技术。

faculty.name: David Boas
faculty.summary: Studies neurovascular coupling and cerebral oxygen delivery using neurophotonics techniques in both humans and rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经血管耦合和脑部氧输送，使用神经光学生物学技术，涵盖人类和啮齿动物。

faculty.name: Camron Bryant
faculty.summary: Studies genetic mechanisms of addiction, focusing on signaling pathways and conditioned behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾的遗传机制，重点关注信号通路和条件行为。

faculty.name: Gail Carpenter
faculty.summary: Studies how neural models derive consistent knowledge from inconsistent information, using computational analysis and dynamical systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经模型如何从不一致的信息中提取一致的知识，使用计算分析和动力系统方法。

faculty.name: Jerry Chen
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between local circuits and long-range networks in the mammalian neocortex using large-scale in vivo imaging and molecular tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物新皮层局部回路与长距离网络之间的关系，使用大规模在体成像技术和分子工具。

faculty.name: Michael Cohen
faculty.summary: Studies speech and language processing using neural modeling and dynamical systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语音和语言处理，使用神经建模和动力系统方法。

faculty.name: Pietro Cottone
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological bases of stress-related disorders and eating behaviors, using animal models and molecular approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力相关障碍和进食行为的神经生物学基础，使用动物模型和分子方法。

faculty.name: Ian Davison
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits underlying perception and behavior in the olfactory system, using genetic tools and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究嗅觉系统中感知和行为的神经回路，使用基因工具和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Brian DePasquale
faculty.summary: Develops mathematical models to understand how populations of neurons perform computations for behavior, using both data-driven and theoretical approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发数学模型以理解神经元群体如何进行计算以产生行为，采用数据驱动和理论两种方法。

faculty.name: Anna Devor
faculty.summary: Studies brain activity across scales, from cellular to macroscopic, using imaging and modeling techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究从细胞到宏观尺度的大脑活动，使用成像和建模技术。

faculty.name: Michael Economo
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits controlling movement using optical, electrophysiological, and genetic tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究控制运动的神经回路，使用光学、电生理和遗传工具进行记录和操控神经活动。

faculty.name: Uri Tzvi Eden
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods to analyze neural spiking activity, integrating model identification and signal processing to dynamically model individual and ensemble neuron properties.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发统计方法分析神经放电活动，整合模型识别和信号处理技术，动态建模单个和神经元群的性质。

faculty.name: David Farb
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive enhancers for Alzheimer’s disease using in vivo electrophysiology to assess hippocampal systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的认知增强剂，使用体内电生理学评估海马系统。

faculty.name: Daniel Fulford
faculty.summary: Studies severe mental illnesses like schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, focusing on motivation and self-management.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究严重的精神疾病（如精神分裂症和双相情感障碍），重点关注动机和自我管理。

faculty.name: Simone Gill
faculty.summary: Studies how individuals' bodies and environmental demands influence walking and motor functioning across the lifespan, using motion capture and wearable technology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体的身体特征和环境需求如何影响其一生中的行走和运动功能，使用动作捕捉和可穿戴技术。

faculty.name: Frank Guenther
faculty.summary: Studies the neural computations underlying speech motor control using theoretical modeling, behavioral experiments, and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语音运动控制的神经计算，使用理论建模、行为实验和神经成像。

faculty.name: Xue Han
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuitry and neuromodulation therapies for brain disorders using optogenetics and deep brain stimulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和神经调节疗法治疗脑部疾病，使用光遗传学和深脑刺激技术。

faculty.name: Angela Ho
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of neuron movement and brain development, and the cell biology of amyloid peptides in Alzheimer’s disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元迁移和大脑发育的分子机制以及阿尔茨海默病中淀粉样肽的细胞生物学。

faculty.name: Allyn Hubbard
faculty.summary: Studies the electromechanical properties of the cochlea and models auditory function, applying microcircuit technology to brain probes and neuromorphic computer architectures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究耳蜗的电磁机械特性并建模听觉功能，应用微电路技术到脑探针和类脑计算机架构。

faculty.name: Kathleen Kantak
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive aspects of addiction-related behavior using animal models and translational approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾相关行为的认知方面，使用动物模型和转化方法。

faculty.name: Terrence Keane
faculty.summary: Studies PTSD, using research methods in psychiatry and clinical psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究 PTSD，采用精神病学和临床心理学的方法。

faculty.name: Gerald Kidd
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes complex sounds in noisy environments and how hearing loss affects sound discrimination and auditory processing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑在嘈杂环境中处理复杂声音的方式以及听力损失如何影响声音辨别和听觉处理。

faculty.name: Swathi Kiran
faculty.summary: Studies language recovery in aphasia, using functional neuroimaging to understand impairments in naming, reading, and writing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究失语症的语言恢复，使用功能性神经影像学理解命名、阅读和书写障碍。

faculty.name: Vijaya B. Kolachala
faculty.summary: Develops software frameworks for dementia screening and clinical-grade digital pathology tools, focusing on domain generalization and representation learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发用于痴呆筛查的软件框架和临床级数字病理学工具，重点在于领域泛化和表示学习。

faculty.name: Mark Kon
faculty.summary: Studies machine learning and quantum probability in bioinformatics and computational biology, focusing on gene regulatory networks and cancer identification.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究机器学习和量子概率在生物信息学和计算生物学中的应用，特别是在基因调控网络和癌症识别方面。

faculty.name: Nancy Kopell
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain produces its dynamics, how brain rhythms contribute to cognition, and how pathologies of brain dynamics relate to neurological diseases and altered states of consciousness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑动态的产生机制，脑节奏在认知中的作用，以及脑动态病理如何与神经疾病和意识改变相关。

faculty.name: Mark Kramer
faculty.summary: Studies biophysical models of neural activity and data analysis techniques, with a focus on medical applications.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经活动的生物物理模型和数据分析技术，重点关注医学应用。

faculty.name: Arthur Sangil Lee
faculty.summary: Studies neural patterns decoding mental states and predicting behaviors using functional neuroimaging methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究通过神经模式解码心理状态和预测行为，使用功能性神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Kimberly Leite-Morris
faculty.summary: Studies the neurochemical mechanisms of ethanol and substance abuse, using rodent models and in vivo microdialysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究乙醇和物质滥用的神经化学机制，使用啮齿动物模型和在 vivo 微透析方法。

faculty.name: Laura Lewis
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain dynamically shifts its functional properties, using computational and signal processing approaches to analyze neuroimaging data at subsecond timescales.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何动态改变其功能属性，使用计算和信号处理方法分析神经成像数据的亚秒级时间尺度。

faculty.name: Michael Lyons
faculty.summary: Studies genetic influences on psychopathology, substance abuse, and aging using twin studies and MRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理障碍、物质滥用和衰老的遗传影响，使用双胞胎研究和MRI。

faculty.name: Hengye Man
faculty.summary: Studies synaptic plasticity, AMPA receptor trafficking, homeostatic synaptic plasticity, and autism spectrum disorders using molecular and cellular techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究突触可塑性、AMPA受体转运、稳态突触可塑性和自闭症谱系障碍，采用分子和细胞技术。

faculty.name: Melanie Matthies
faculty.summary: Studies the role of hearing in adult speech motor control using various listener groups, including cochlear implant recipients and elderly subjects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听力在成人发音运动控制中的作用，使用各种听者群体，包括人工耳蜗植入者和老年人。

faculty.name: Maria Medalla
faculty.summary: Studies the interaction and control of distinct limbic, sensory, and motor networks by the prefrontal cortex in primates, using electrophysiological and anatomical techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物边缘、感觉和运动网络如何由前额叶皮层调控，采用电生理和解剖学技术。

faculty.name: Tara Moore
faculty.summary: Studies recovery of fine motor function and re-organization of the motor cortex after cortical injury in non-human primates, using exosomes and therapeutics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非人灵长类动物皮层损伤后的精细运动功能恢复和运动皮层重组，使用外泌体和治疗性药物。

faculty.name: Hamid Nawab
faculty.summary: Studies complex signal processing for biosignals, integrating artificial intelligence and signal interpretation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生物信号的复杂信号处理，结合人工智能和信号解释。

faculty.name: Gabriel Ocker
faculty.summary: Studies how neural activity encodes sensory information and drives behavior using models of neuronal networks and dynamical systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经活动如何编码感官信息并驱动行为，使用神经网络模型和动力系统工具。

faculty.name: Tyler Perrachione
faculty.summary: Studies the brain bases of complex auditory processing, including speech and voice perception, and mechanisms of plasticity in the human auditory cortex, particularly in developmental disorders like.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂听觉处理的脑基础，包括语音和声音感知，以及人类听皮层可塑性的机制，特别是在发育障碍如阅读障碍中的应用。

faculty.name: Wendy Qiu
faculty.summary: Studies the fundamental causational mechanisms of Alzheimer’s disease and seeks biomarkers for diagnosis and treatment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的基本致病机制，并寻找诊断和治疗的精神疾病生物标志物。

faculty.name: Yakeel T Quiroz
faculty.summary: Studies early cognitive and biological markers of Alzheimer’s disease, focusing on Colombian families with early-onset autosomal dominant Alzheimer’s disease (ADAD) to identify protective mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病早期的认知和生物标志物，重点关注携带早发性常染色体显性遗传阿尔茨海默病（ADAD）突变的哥伦比亚家庭，以识别保护机制。

faculty.name: Robert Reinhart
faculty.summary: Studies the nature of visual perception and cognition, particularly attention, working memory, and executive control, using EEG and neuromodulation techniques to develop interventions for cognitive.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和认知（注意、工作记忆和执行控制）的性质，使用EEG和神经调节技术开发认知优化干预措施。

faculty.name: Douglas Rosene
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive aging and recovery of motor function after stroke in rhesus monkeys, using MRI and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知老化和中风后精细运动功能恢复的神经生物学基础，使用MRI和行为实验在恒河猴模型中进行研究。

faculty.name: Jean-Pierre Roussarie
faculty.summary: Studies the early stages of Alzheimer’s disease in the entorhinal cortex, focusing on layer II neurons and their molecular characteristics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病早期阶段内嗅皮层的层II神经元及其分子特征。

faculty.name: R. J. Rushmore III
faculty.summary: Studies brain function and restoration after injury, focusing on cortical spreading depression and visual neglect.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑功能和损伤后的恢复，重点关注皮层扩散抑郁和视觉忽视。

faculty.name: Valentina Sabino
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of addiction and stress-related disorders, focusing on alcohol abuse and anxiety, using animal models and interdisciplinary approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾和压力相关障碍（如酒精滥用和焦虑）的神经生物学机制，采用动物模型和跨学科方法。

faculty.name: Karin Schon
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of aerobic exercise on cognitive function and brain health in aging and Alzheimer’s disease using MRI, behavioral tests, and biomarker assays.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究有氧运动对衰老和阿尔茨海默病认知功能和脑健康的影响，使用MRI、行为测试和生物标志物分析。

faculty.name: Kamal Sen
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons encode complex natural sounds, using electrophysiological techniques and theoretical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元如何编码复杂自然声音，使用电生理技术和理论方法。

faculty.name: Cassandra Smith
faculty.summary: Studies genetic and molecular factors in schizophrenia and autism, focusing on epigenetics and metabolomics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症和自闭症的遗传和分子因素，重点关注表观遗传学和代谢组学。

faculty.name: Matthias Stangl
faculty.summary: Studies how the human brain supports cognitive functions like spatial navigation and memory, using deep brain recordings, fMRI, and EEG.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何支持空间导航和记忆等认知功能，采用深部脑电记录、功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和脑电图(EEG)等方法。

faculty.name: H. Eugene Stanley
faculty.summary: Studies the anomalous behavior of liquid water and brain circuits, focusing on complex systems and interdisciplinary puzzles.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究液态水的异常行为和脑回路，专注于复杂系统和跨学科问题。

faculty.name: Emily Stephen
faculty.summary: Studies how electrical and magnetic fields propagate in the brain, using statistical models to bridge spatial scales.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中电场和磁场的传播，使用统计模型跨越空间尺度。

faculty.name: Cara Stepp
faculty.summary: Studies disordered human communication, applying engineering tools to better understand and rehabilitate voice and speech systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类沟通障碍，应用工程工具更好地理解并康复语音和言语系统。

faculty.name: Robert Stern
faculty.summary: Studies the long-term effects of repetitive brain trauma in athletes, focusing on diagnosing and treating CTE and Alzheimer’s disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动员反复脑创伤的长期影响，重点在于诊断和治疗CTE和阿尔茨海默病。

faculty.name: Helen Tager-Flusberg
faculty.summary: Studies the early behavioral and brain development in infants at risk for autism, comparing autism and specific language impairment in children, and examines minimally verbal children with autism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症风险婴儿的早期行为和大脑发育，比较自闭症与特定语言障碍儿童的行为和功能性磁共振成像，以及研究自闭症的最小语言能力儿童。

faculty.name: Louis Toth
faculty.summary: Studies the physiology of information transmission in the normal mammalian brain using imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究正常哺乳动物大脑中信息传递的生理机制，使用成像技术。

faculty.name: James Traniello
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of social behavior in ants, using immunohistochemistry and pharmacological interventions to understand collective intelligence and brain evolution.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究蚂蚁的社会行为的神经生物学，使用免疫组织化学和药理学干预来理解集体智能和大脑进化。

faculty.name: Lucia Vaina
faculty.summary: Studies visual motion analysis in the human brain using computational, psychophysical, and neuroimaging methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑中的视觉运动分析，使用计算、心理物理学和神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: Mieke Verfaellie
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of human memory through patients with memory disorders and individuals with intact memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类记忆的认知和神经基础，通过记忆障碍患者和记忆正常个体进行研究。

faculty.name: Michael Wallace
faculty.summary: Studies how specific circuits in the basal ganglia guide motivated behaviors and control motor actions using electrophysiology and in vivo optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基底节特定回路如何指导动机行为和控制运动动作，使用电生理学和体内光遗传学技术。

faculty.name: Gloria Waters
faculty.summary: Studies language and memory processes, using federal and foundation grants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言和记忆过程，使用联邦和基金会资助。

faculty.name: Meg Younger
faculty.summary: Studies how mosquitoes detect and encode human odors, using calcium imaging and neurophysiology to understand biting behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究蚊子如何检测和编码人类气味，使用钙成像和神经生理学方法理解叮咬行为。

faculty.name: Venetia Zachariou
faculty.summary: Investigates molecular mechanisms of chronic pain using genomic analysis, genetic mouse models, and epigenetic studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究慢性疼痛的分子机制，使用基因组分析、遗传小鼠模型和表观遗传学研究。

faculty.name: Basilis Zikopoulos
faculty.summary: Studies the structural organization and connections of brain circuits in humans and animal models, using microscopy and imaging to understand neuropathology in attention, mood, and anxiety disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类和动物模型的大脑回路的结构组织和连接，使用显微镜和成像技术来理解注意、情绪和焦虑障碍等神经病理学。

faculty.name: Jennifer Zuk
faculty.summary: Studies factors in early childhood that shape speech, language, and reading acquisition, using behavioral and neuroimaging tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期儿童因素如何塑造语言、阅读能力的发展，使用行为和神经成像工具。
